seccion.titulo: Do your ads bring leads, or do they bring sales?
seccion.cierre: The report arrives on its own. The answers, whenever you ask.

casos.proactivo: ☀️ Good morning. Yesterday you spent US$ 214 across 5 campaigns and got 38 leads: US$ 5.60 each, 12% less than last week. "Remarketing" has been spending for 3 days with no results. Reply VIEW for the details.

comandos.u: Which campaign brought the most leads yesterday, and what did each one cost me?
comandos.r: "September leads" brought 21 at US$ 4.10. Next is "Catalog" with 11 at US$ 7.30. The other three added up to 6.

comandos.u: Compare this week with last week: spend, leads and cost per lead.
comandos.r: Spend US$ 1,480 (+6%), 265 leads (+19%), cost per lead US$ 5.58 (−11%). The jump comes from "September leads": it doubled leads on the same budget.

comandos.u: Which ad is spending and bringing nothing?
comandos.r: "Remarketing" has spent US$ 96 in 3 days without a single lead, at a frequency of 4.8: the audience has seen it too often. Pause it?

comandos.u: How many of this month's Meta leads already have an appointment or quote in the CRM?
comandos.r: Of 612 Meta leads, 148 have an appointment or quote in HubSpot (24%). "September leads" converts at 31%; "Catalog", at 9%.

comandos.u: Send me the weekly summary every Monday at 8 with the campaigns I need to review.
comandos.r: Done. Every Monday at 8:00 you get spend, leads, cost per lead and the campaigns out of range. The first one arrives Monday the 15th.

casos.resultado: Zero minutes in Ads Manager. Every budget decision, with the numbers in front of you.
